name: High Rise
summary: At Thunder Bluff's summit, High Rise draws the tauren tribes to its central fire above Mulgore.

sections.title: Summit of the Mesa
sections.body:
You find the High Rise at Thunder Bluff's summit, where open winds sweep over Mulgore's rolling plains. Tauren gather in its open-air amphitheater around a fire pit to hear tribal announcements and witness decisions. Tents and wooden stalls house merchants, armories, and culinary trainers, including Aska's Kitchen and Mountaintop Bait & Tackle.

Massive wooden elevators connect the lower tiers to Mulgore's prairie floor, but none reaches the High Rise from the plains. To climb here, take the way up from the wind rider roost or cross a rope bridge from Elder Rise or Hunter Rise.

faq.q: How do you reach the High Rise?
aliases: how to get to high rise
faq.answer: Reach the High Rise from the lower tiers by way of the central wind rider roost, or cross a suspension bridge from Elder Rise or Hunter Rise. No lift connects the Mulgore plains directly to this tier.

faq.q: What services are found on the High Rise?
faq.answer: Tradesfolk and outdoor gathering places fill the High Rise. Aska's Kitchen teaches cooking, Mountaintop Bait & Tackle sells fishing gear, and Ragetotem Arms and Thunderhoof's Firearms are among the weapon merchants.

faq.q: What is the amphitheater on the High Rise used for?
faq.answer: The open-air amphitheater gathers tauren around a central bonfire. There they hear news, deliberate tribal affairs, and witness important proclamations atop the mesa.

angles.text: At Aska's Kitchen on the High Rise, you can learn cooking from the pit masters over an open flame. It is Thunder Bluff's main place to learn the craft.
As a tauren, you see High Rise crown your capital and bring the tribes together. Hunters, shamans, and elders gather around its high communal fire.
